frameworks.change: Today net8.0;net10.0 only (no netstandard2.0, so PSWriteOffice excludes it on net472). Moving to netstandard2.0 needs polyfills for: ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull (235 uses), SHA256.HashData (23), Convert.ToHexString (29), Path.GetRelativePath (11), File.Move(..., overwrite) (12), File.*Async (5), Parallel.ForEachAsync (1), range/index syntax (8), init/required/records (C# features work with polyfill attributes), ImplicitUsings. OfficeConverter and the batch engine move to the OfficeIMO front door, which targets net10.0 only (design: Packages), so the batch engine needs no netstandard2.0 port; .NET Framework callers use the format and adapter packages directly.

notes: Workflows references 35 projects (Invoicing, Project, Visio, OCR, DjVu, CHM, Email, EPUB, ...). OfficeConverter cannot absorb Workflows wholesale into the front door without pulling all of them in; see OfficeIMO.json.
